members.name: banking_intents_v1
members.instructions: A customer sent this message to a digital bank's support chat. Which intent best describes what the customer is asking about or reporting? Pick the single most specific matching intent.

criteria.activate_my_card: How to activate a card they have received; activation not working or failing.
criteria.age_limit: Minimum age to open an account or use the service; whether children/teenagers can have an account.
criteria.apple_pay_or_google_pay: Using or adding the card to Apple Pay, Google Pay or Android Pay; topping up with them; it not working.
criteria.atm_support: Where to find ATMs, which ATMs accept the card, whether the card can be used at a specific ATM (not about fees, declines or wrong cash).
criteria.automatic_top_up: The auto top-up feature: how it works, setting it up, turning it off, why it did not trigger.
criteria.balance_not_updated_after_bank_transfer: The user made a bank transfer INTO their own account (typically from their UK account or another bank) and it is not showing in the balance yet: 'how long does a transfer from a UK account take, I just made one and it doesn't appear', 'please check my UK account, I made the transfer a couple of hours ago', balance unchanged after a transfer in.
criteria.balance_not_updated_after_cheque_or_cash: Money the user deposited or 'put into' the account (cash or cheque) has not appeared yet; 'still awaiting the money I put into my account this morning'; cheque slow to clear.
criteria.beneficiary_not_allowed: Cannot add a beneficiary/payee/recipient; the beneficiary is not allowed or rejected.
criteria.cancel_transfer: Wants to cancel or reverse a transfer or payment they made (sent to the wrong account, changed their mind).
criteria.card_about_to_expire: Card is expiring or expired; what happens when it expires; getting a replacement for an expiring card.
criteria.card_acceptance: Where the card is accepted; a merchant or shop that does not accept the card; whether it can be used for certain purchases.
criteria.card_arrival: A physical card that was ordered/sent has not arrived yet; tracking the card in the post; card is late.
criteria.card_delivery_estimate: How long a new card takes to be delivered, delivery time or options (express), whether it can be delivered to a given place, before it is late.
criteria.card_linking: Linking a card to the app/account, adding a card that was found or already received to the app, re-linking a card.
criteria.card_not_working: The card is not working in general: it fails at several shops/places, the user cannot use it at all, or asks what to do because the card doesn't work. NOT when the problem is at an ATM ('my card won't work at an ATM' is declined_cash_withdrawal) and NOT a declined purchase at one shop ('couldn't get my card to work at a shop' is declined_card_payment).
criteria.card_payment_fee_charged: Charged a fee for a card payment/purchase; why some payments have fees; paying more than the price for a card payment; hidden fees on payments.
criteria.card_payment_not_recognised: A payment/charge/transaction on the statement or app that the user does not recognise, did not make or did not authorise, including when they suspect fraud.
criteria.card_payment_wrong_exchange_rate: Wrong or bad exchange rate applied to a card payment/purchase in a foreign currency.
criteria.card_swallowed: The ATM kept/swallowed/ate the card and did not return it.
criteria.cash_withdrawal_charge: Charged a fee for withdrawing cash at an ATM; why cash withdrawals cost money; 'why did I get charged a fee, I thought it was free?' (a fee on something they believed was free, which is usually ATM withdrawals).
criteria.cash_withdrawal_not_recognised: A cash withdrawal on the account that the user did not make or does not recognise, even if they suspect their card was copied or someone has their details; 'my app is showing a cash withdrawal / cash balance that I did not receive'.
criteria.change_pin: Changing the card PIN or choosing/creating a new PIN of their own ('help me set up a new PIN', 'can I create my own PIN'), or where (e.g. which ATMs) the PIN can be changed (PIN not blocked).
criteria.compromised_card: The user explicitly says their card details have been compromised, stolen, skimmed, or that someone else has access to their card, and asks what to do (without pointing at a specific unrecognised payment or withdrawal).
criteria.contactless_not_working: Contactless payments (tap to pay) are not working.
criteria.country_support: Which countries the service or card is available/supported in; can I use it or open an account if I live in a certain country.
criteria.declined_card_payment: A card payment/purchase was declined, rejected or did not work at a shop, restaurant or online, e.g. 'my card was declined', 'I could not get my card to work at a shop', 'why was my payment declined'.
criteria.declined_cash_withdrawal: The user could not withdraw cash: the ATM declined the card or the withdrawal, 'my card won't work at an ATM', the ATM refused to give money.
criteria.declined_transfer: A transfer was declined or rejected by the bank; told transfer not possible.
criteria.direct_debit_payment_not_recognised: A direct debit payment the user did not set up or does not recognise.
criteria.disposable_card_limits: Limits of disposable virtual cards: how many times they can be used, maximum amounts, restrictions.
criteria.edit_personal_details: Changing personal details such as name, address, email or phone number on the account.
criteria.exchange_charge: Fees or charges for exchanging currency; is there a cost to exchange money; discounts on exchange for frequent exchanging.
criteria.exchange_rate: What exchange rate is used, where rates come from, how rates are determined, the current rate for a currency (not a complaint about a specific wrong rate, not fees or discounts).
criteria.exchange_via_app: How to exchange or convert currencies in the app; which currencies can be exchanged.
criteria.extra_charge_on_statement: A specific unexplained extra small amount (e.g. an extra £1 / $1 / €1) appearing on the statement; why is there an extra pound/dollar charge.
criteria.failed_transfer: A transfer failed or did not go through; the money came back.
criteria.fiat_currency_support: Which fiat currencies the account can hold or exchange into; whether a specific currency is supported for holding money; 'what currencies can my account be in?'.
criteria.get_disposable_virtual_card: How to get or create a disposable (one-time) virtual card.
criteria.get_physical_card: Getting the PIN for the physical card: where to find the PIN, PIN not received, whether the card has a PIN, how to get the PIN or set the PIN of the physical card specifically ('how do I set my physical card PIN?').
criteria.getting_spare_card: Getting an additional/spare/extra/another card, e.g. 'how do I order another card', a card for a family member, fees for another card, how many cards they can have.
criteria.getting_virtual_card: How to get or order a virtual card, cost of virtual cards, a virtual card the user ordered not showing up yet.
criteria.lost_or_stolen_card: The card has been lost or stolen; the user wants to freeze or block their card immediately; what to do after losing the card.
criteria.lost_or_stolen_phone: The phone was lost or stolen; how to access or protect the account without the phone.
criteria.order_physical_card: Ordering a physical card: how to order, whether it costs anything / is free, fees for a new card, delivery address, wanting a plastic card.
criteria.passcode_forgotten: Forgot the app passcode or password; resetting the passcode.
criteria.pending_card_payment: A card payment or purchase is still pending or hasn't gone through yet; a purchase the user paid for is not showing as completed; how long card payments stay pending.
criteria.pending_cash_withdrawal: A cash withdrawal is pending or in progress; e.g. 'I didn't receive my money earlier and it says the transaction is still in progress' (ATM did not give the money but the withdrawal shows as in progress).
criteria.pending_top_up: A top-up is still pending or taking a long time to complete.
criteria.pending_transfer: An outgoing transfer or transaction explicitly shown as pending / not cleared / still in progress, e.g. 'when will the transaction post to my account', 'my account transfer was not cleared', 'why is my transaction taking so long to complete'. Not a transfer from the user's own UK/other-bank account into this account (balance_not_updated_after_bank_transfer), not card payments, top-ups or ATM withdrawals.
criteria.pin_blocked: The PIN or card is blocked after too many wrong PIN attempts; how to unblock it.
criteria.receiving_money: How to receive money or a salary into the account; whether friends or others can send the user money, including in other currencies.
criteria.Refund_not_showing_up: A refund that the user already asked for or the merchant issued has not appeared yet; 'I requested a refund from the seller a week ago and still nothing'; still waiting for a refund.
criteria.request_refund: Wants a refund or money back for a purchase, wants to cancel a purchase, or asks how long it generally takes to get a refund for something bought (no refund requested yet).
criteria.reverted_card_payment?: A card payment was reverted, returned or reversed (e.g. the seller says the money didn't go through and it came back) and the user wants to know why.
criteria.supported_cards_and_currencies: Which cards (Visa, Mastercard, American Express) and which currencies can be used with the account or for topping up; 'what currencies can I use?', 'what payment methods are accepted to add funds?'.
criteria.top_up_by_bank_transfer_charge: Fees for topping up by bank transfer; whether the bank receives SWIFT / international transfers into the account and what they cost.
criteria.top_up_by_card_charge: Fees charged for topping up with a card, including fees for adding money in a foreign currency such as USD.
criteria.top_up_by_cash_or_cheque: Topping up with cash or a cheque; depositing cash/cheque.
criteria.top_up_failed: A top-up attempt failed, was declined or gave an error and did not go through.
criteria.top_up_limits: Maximum or minimum top-up amounts; limits on topping up.
criteria.top_up_reverted: A top-up was cancelled, reverted or taken back, or the user topped up/recharged but the money was not credited or disappeared; 'why was my top-up cancelled?'.
criteria.topping_up_by_card: How to top up / add money using a debit or credit card; transferring money in with a credit card; whether other people can top up the user's account.
criteria.transaction_charged_twice: The same transaction or payment was charged twice; duplicate charge.
criteria.transfer_fee_charged: Charged a fee for a transfer, or thought transfers were free; also vague fee complaints that name nothing specific, e.g. 'why was I charged?', 'will I get extra charges?', 'why was I charged a higher fee for banking abroad?'.
criteria.transfer_into_account: How bank transfers work / how to transfer money into the account from another account or bank; adding money via bank transfer.
criteria.transfer_not_received_by_recipient: The user sent/transferred money (e.g. to a friend, a retailer, or within the country) and it has not arrived or is 'still not there' after some time; 'I transferred some money but it is not here yet'; the recipient has not received it.
criteria.transfer_timing: How long transfers take to arrive or be processed, including 'it's been a couple of days, how much longer do I have to wait for my transfer?' and waiting for a transfer from abroad; general transfer speed questions.
criteria.unable_to_verify_identity: Problems verifying identity: verification failing, document rejected, cannot complete verification.
criteria.verify_my_identity: How to verify identity; what documents are needed for identity verification.
criteria.verify_source_of_funds: Where the user's money/funds came from: verifying or proving the source of funds, seeing the source of available money ('can I see my available money?', 'where did my money come from?'), how their money is secured.
criteria.verify_top_up: Verifying a top-up or top-up card; finding the verification code for a top-up.
criteria.virtual_card_not_working: A virtual card does not work or is being declined.
criteria.visa_or_mastercard: Whether the card is Visa or Mastercard; wanting or choosing a Visa or a Mastercard; which card networks are offered.
criteria.why_verify_identity: Why identity verification is necessary; why I have to verify.
criteria.wrong_amount_of_cash_received: At the ATM the user got less cash or a different amount than they asked for, while the balance shows the full amount was taken (the user was at the ATM; not a withdrawal they never made).
criteria.wrong_exchange_rate_for_cash_withdrawal: Wrong exchange rate applied to an ATM cash withdrawal abroad.

criteria.exchange_charge: Fees or charges for exchanging currency; is there a cost to exchange money; discounts on exchange for frequent exchanging.
criteria.exchange_rate: What exchange rate is used, where rates come from, how rates are determined, the current rate for a currency (not a complaint about a specific wrong rate, not fees or discounts).
criteria.exchange_via_app: How to exchange or convert currencies in the app; which currencies can be exchanged.
criteria.extra_charge_on_statement: A specific unexplained extra small amount (e.g. an extra £1 / $1 / €1) appearing on the statement; why is there an extra pound/dollar charge.
criteria.failed_transfer: A transfer failed or did not go through; the money came back.
criteria.fiat_currency_support: Which fiat currencies the account can hold or exchange into; whether a specific currency is supported for holding money; 'what currencies can my account be in?'.
criteria.get_disposable_virtual_card: How to get or create a disposable (one-time) virtual card.
criteria.get_physical_card: Getting the PIN for the physical card: where to find the PIN, PIN not received, whether the card has a PIN, how to get the PIN or set the PIN of the physical card specifically ('how do I set my physical card PIN?').
criteria.getting_spare_card: Getting an additional/spare/extra/another card, e.g. 'how do I order another card', a card for a family member, fees for another card, how many cards they can have.
criteria.getting_virtual_card: How to get or order a virtual card, cost of virtual cards, a virtual card the user ordered not showing up yet.
criteria.lost_or_stolen_card: The card has been lost or stolen; the user wants to freeze or block their card immediately; what to do after losing the card.
criteria.lost_or_stolen_phone: The phone was lost or stolen; how to access or protect the account without the phone.
criteria.order_physical_card: Ordering a physical card: how to order, whether it costs anything / is free, fees for a new card, delivery address, wanting a plastic card.
criteria.passcode_forgotten: Forgot the app passcode or password; resetting the passcode.
criteria.pending_card_payment: A card payment or purchase is still pending or hasn't gone through yet; a purchase the user paid for is not showing as completed; how long card payments stay pending.
criteria.pending_cash_withdrawal: A cash withdrawal is pending or in progress; e.g. 'I didn't receive my money earlier and it says the transaction is still in progress' (ATM did not give the money but the withdrawal shows as in progress).
criteria.pending_top_up: A top-up is still pending or taking a long time to complete.
criteria.pending_transfer: An outgoing transfer or transaction explicitly shown as pending / not cleared / still in progress, e.g. 'when will the transaction post to my account', 'my account transfer was not cleared', 'why is my transaction taking so long to complete'. Not a transfer from the user's own UK/other-bank account into this account (balance_not_updated_after_bank_transfer), not card payments, top-ups or ATM withdrawals.
criteria.pin_blocked: The PIN or card is blocked after too many wrong PIN attempts; how to unblock it.
criteria.receiving_money: How to receive money or a salary into the account; whether friends or others can send the user money, including in other currencies.
criteria.Refund_not_showing_up: A refund that the user already asked for or the merchant issued has not appeared yet; 'I requested a refund from the seller a week ago and still nothing'; still waiting for a refund.
criteria.request_refund: Wants a refund or money back for a purchase, wants to cancel a purchase, or asks how long it generally takes to get a refund for something bought (no refund requested yet).
criteria.reverted_card_payment?: A card payment was reverted, returned or reversed (e.g. the seller says the money didn't go through and it came back) and the user wants to know why.
criteria.supported_cards_and_currencies: Which cards (Visa, Mastercard, American Express) and which currencies can be used with the account or for topping up; 'what currencies can I use?', 'what payment methods are accepted to add funds?'.
criteria.top_up_by_bank_transfer_charge: Fees for topping up by bank transfer; whether the bank receives SWIFT / international transfers into the account and what they cost.
criteria.top_up_by_card_charge: Fees charged for topping up with a card, including fees for adding money in a foreign currency such as USD.
criteria.top_up_by_cash_or_cheque: Topping up with cash or a cheque; depositing cash/cheque.
criteria.top_up_failed: A top-up attempt failed, was declined or gave an error and did not go through.
criteria.top_up_limits: Maximum or minimum top-up amounts; limits on topping up.
criteria.top_up_reverted: A top-up was cancelled, reverted or taken back, or the user topped up/recharged but the money was not credited or disappeared; 'why was my top-up cancelled?'.
criteria.topping_up_by_card: How to top up / add money using a debit or credit card; transferring money in with a credit card; whether other people can top up the user's account.
criteria.transaction_charged_twice: The same transaction or payment was charged twice; duplicate charge.
criteria.transfer_fee_charged: Charged a fee for a transfer, or thought transfers were free; also vague fee complaints that name nothing specific, e.g. 'why was I charged?', 'will I get extra charges?', 'why was I charged a higher fee for banking abroad?'.
criteria.transfer_into_account: How bank transfers work / how to transfer money into the account from another account or bank; adding money via bank transfer.
criteria.transfer_not_received_by_recipient: The user sent/transferred money (e.g. to a friend, a retailer, or within the country) and it has not arrived or is 'still not there' after some time; 'I transferred some money but it is not here yet'; the recipient has not received it.
criteria.transfer_timing: How long transfers take to arrive or be processed, including 'it's been a couple of days, how much longer do I have to wait for my transfer?' and waiting for a transfer from abroad; general transfer speed questions.
criteria.unable_to_verify_identity: Problems verifying identity: verification failing, document rejected, cannot complete verification.
criteria.verify_my_identity: How to verify identity; what documents are needed for identity verification.
criteria.verify_source_of_funds: Where the user's money/funds came from: verifying or proving the source of funds, seeing the source of available money ('can I see my available money?', 'where did my money come from?'), how their money is secured.
criteria.verify_top_up: Verifying a top-up or top-up card; finding the verification code for a top-up.
criteria.virtual_card_not_working: A virtual card does not work or is being declined.
criteria.visa_or_mastercard: Whether the card is Visa or Mastercard; wanting or choosing a Visa or a Mastercard; which card networks are offered.
criteria.why_verify_identity: Why identity verification is necessary; why I have to verify.
criteria.wrong_amount_of_cash_received: At the ATM the user got less cash or a different amount than they asked for, while the balance shows the full amount was taken (the user was at the ATM; not a withdrawal they never made).
criteria.wrong_exchange_rate_for_cash_withdrawal: Wrong exchange rate applied to an ATM cash withdrawal abroad.
